quotations.old_english: Hé hiene bedǽlþ ðære oncnáwnesse ðæs uplecan leóhtes
quotations.latin: a luce se supernae cognitionis excludit

source_text: on-cnáwness, e; f. Knowledge, conception :-- Hé hiene bedǽlþ ðære oncnáwnesse ðæs uplecan leóhtes a luce se supernae cognitionis excludit, Past. 11, 4; Swt. 69, 24.
